title: The bootstrap config, version 1
description: The policy document a collector serves at GET /v1/bootstrap and the relay carries to the executor at http://artifacts/bootstrap. It carries policy only: no path, file content, command or environment variable. bootstrap-config/v1.md is normative; this schema is the form a producer sends (BOOTCFG-1).

version.description: The config format's version. Always the integer 1 in this version of the document.

trust.description: The guest's system trust policy. Absent, it is the policy whose mode is append.

mode.description: append: the relay's CA is added to the guest's system roots. exclusive: the relay's CA is the guest's only system root. Absent, the mode is append.
